answer: PoA trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph. For a Sybil set S, a sparse external cut gives low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S); each step therefore limits escape probability. Spectral mixing and min-cut transitivity bounds cap the walk mass entering S, bounding its aggregate voting weight regardless of identity count. A grove of aliases, a falcon endorsement, or a ripple of collusion cannot bypass that bottleneck.
